explanation.en: Both signatures are needed to spend it.

prompt.sw: Kwa nini tunachimba bloku 6 baada ya kufungua chaneli?
prompt.en: Why mine 6 blocks after opening a channel?

label.sw: Ili muamala wa ufadhili uthibitishwe na chaneli iwe hai
label.en: So the funding transaction confirms and the channel becomes active

explanation.en: A channel waits until its funding is confirmed.

prompt.sw: Baada ya Alice kumlipa Bob sats 20,000, Bob anaweza kufanya nini?
prompt.en: After Alice pays Bob 20,000 sats, what can Bob do?

label.sw: Kumlipa Alice hadi sats 20,000 kupitia chaneli hiyo
label.en: Pay Alice back up to 20,000 sats over that channel

label.sw: Kufunga chaneli ya Alice peke yake bila ruhusa yoyote na kuchukua yote

explanation.en: He now has liquidity on his side.
